Ganga Sweets Rep. by its Partner K.Nallaiah S/o. Krishnasamy No.183/15, G.N.T. Road Redhills, Chennai 600 052. .. Petitioner Vs. 1. The Revenue Divisional Officer Ponneri, Tiruvallur District. 2. The Tashildar Ponneri, Tiruvallur District. 3. The Executive Officer Naravarikuppam Town Panchayat Ponneri, Tiruvallur District. 4. P.Saravanakumar .. Respondents Prayer: Writ Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of Indi praying for a writ of Mandamus directing the first respondent to pa orders on the petitioner's representation dated 06.04.2023 for Page 1 of 5 M/S. Ganga Sweets vs The Revenue Divisional Officer on 24 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39902675/ 1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.No.16 removing the encroachment made in front of the petitioner's shop at No.183/15, Gnt Road, Redhills, Chennai 600 052 within a stipulated period as fixed by this Court. For the Petitioner : Mr.G.Parthasarathy For the Respondents : Mr.P.Muthukumar State Government Pleade for Respondents 1 to 3
texts.facts: The petitioner seeks a direction to the first respondent to pass orders on their representation dated 06.04.2023 for removing the encroachment made in front of their shop at No.183/15, GNT Road, Redhills, Chennai 600 052. 2. According to the petitioner, they are running a shop in No.183/15, GNT Road, Red Hills, Chennai, registered under the Food Safety and Standard Authority of India. The official respondents, for the purpose of putting up drainage and sewage pipes, digged the road in front of their shop. The fourth respondent and the roadside vendors, taking advantage of the same, encroached the entire front side of https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis their shop and put up roadside shops. When it was resisted by them, they were prevented by the fourth respondent and the roadside vendors from running the shop. Hence, they made a representation to the first respondent on 06.04.2023. As it did not evoke any response, they have come up with this writ petition.
